# Dimas Akbar

dimasakbar.xyz is the personal portfolio of Dimas Akbar, a freelance web developer and Informatics Engineering student at Universitas Pamulang in Indonesia.

## Primary Topics

- React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS frontend development
- Responsive web interfaces and interactive user experiences
- Android performance projects, Magisk modules, and custom kernel work
- Certificates, learning journey, selected projects, and contact information

## Selected Projects

- TechFix Software — Android technical-service platform built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS: https://techfixsoftware.my.id/
- Kalkulator Pajak UMKM — React and Vite web app for estimating 0.5% UMKM final income tax: https://kalkulator-pajak-umkm.vercel.app/
- Gabut Remake — shell-based Magisk module for MediaTek Android devices
- Phoneix-Next — custom Android kernel for Redmi Note 9 (Merlinx)
- MyCash — web billing and payment portal built with Next.js 16, Supabase and TypeScript: https://mycash-delta.vercel.app (source: https://github.com/DimasAkbarF/MyC4sh)
